description: This file defines a React component 'DevicesPage' that displays a list of devices with functionalities such as sorting, pagination, exporting, and viewing device details in a modal dialog. It fetches device data via react-query hooks and renders a Material-UI based interface.

methods.name: handlePageChange
methods.description: Handles pagination changes by updating the current page and page size states.

methods.name: toggleSort
methods.description: Toggles sorting order between ascending and descending for the specified field.

methods.name: handleCloseDetails
methods.description: Closes the device details dialog by resetting the selected device ID.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Returns color code based on device status ('online', 'offline', or default).
